decisions.reason: Correctly locates index.js:3 inject=["apiProxy"] and index.js:9 ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers(), and flags the dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency at package.json:17 as declared-but-never-imported. However, it maps the break to the retirement card only by content without identifying A1-01 (stating the corridor was absent) and never explains the concrete migration via llm injection / listProviders, giving only generic token/call-form replacement advice.

All six non-behavioral categories are accounted for with concrete scanned-file evidence (package.json fields and line cites, cordis.patch.yml:1-3, grep sweeps for config, lifecycle, network, and host surfaces). session-notes.js is correctly dismissed as pure string/array utilities with no importers, cordis.patch.yml is treated as ordinary descriptor composition without denying its existence or misreading the insert as host-source modification, and no coupling is invented from filenames.

Explicitly argues that zero static hits cannot establish compatibility because grep coverage is limited and semantic, dependency, descriptor-validation, and runtime behavior need separate evidence, and it clearly separates the single decisive apiProxy break from the six zero-hit categories, concluding known-incompatible until migrated rather than roughly compatible.

Specifies post-migration install/build/typecheck against 0.1.2-alpha.2, an isolated-profile cold boot on the target version confirming the plugin activates with inject resolving (no service-not-found/pending), and a functional smoke test that actually exercises the migrated providers call; it explicitly presents these as proposed steps not executed in the static fixture.
